Problem Statement:
Given an array of N integers where each element is in the range [0, K], sort the array in non-decreasing order. Your solution should be optimized for the given
input_spec:
- The first line contains two integers N and K, the size of the array and the maximum value in the array.
- The second line contains N space-separated integers representing the elements of the array.
output_spec: - Print the sorted array as N space-separated integers.
